elevation.$description: STANDARDIZED 2026-10-21 on the stock Tailwind v3 box-shadow scale (shadow-sm, shadow, shadow-md, shadow-lg, shadow-xl, shadow-2xl) — same offsets, blurs, spreads and alphas as Tailwind's own defaults, with one deliberate change: the shadow color is the slate rgb(16 24 40), already a token (extended.dark-slate), instead of pure black, so shadows read cool against Tahche's blue-tinted neutrals. The Figma v2 file's Drop shadow/* effect styles were rewritten to match on the same date (they had drifted, including layers with negative y offsets that cast shadows upward). The Tailwind preset also defines Tailwind's own keys (sm, DEFAULT, md, lg, xl, 2xl) from these tokens, so stock shadow-md and shadow-medium render identically. Real-usage audit (2026-07-23): in every app, developers reach for Tailwind's stock shadow classes alongside — sometimes more than — the named tokens; the aliasing above closes that gap without a lint rule.

xsmall.$description: Tailwind v3 `shadow-sm`. Subtle separation between adjacent surfaces — Input Field/Box (removed entirely when Disabled), Button Group, cards against a page background. The most-used named shadow in the apps.

focus-ring.$description: REPLACED 2026-10-21 (previously a 3px ring at primary-500 / 12% alpha, which measured about 1.2:1 against white — the Figma v2 file's equivalent halo was about 1.3:1). Ring is primary-500: 7.5:1 on white, well past the 3:1 non-text contrast minimum, and thick enough to meet the 2px perimeter in WCAG 2.2's Focus Appearance (2.4.13, AAA). Focus indicator: a 2px gap in the surface color, then a 2px solid ring — Tailwind's classic `ring-2 ring-offset-2` shape, drawn as a box-shadow so it follows border-radius and never shifts layout. Use with `focus-visible`, not `focus`, on buttons, inputs, tabs, links and checkboxes. The gap color is the CSS variable --focus-ring-offset (falls back to white); set it on any non-white surface so the gap matches the background. Light-theme default; on dark surfaces use focus-ring-dark.

focus-ring-dark.$description: Dark-theme counterpart of focus-ring: the ring steps to primary-300 (#8D92EB), 6.5:1 on neutral-900, because primary-500 measures only 2.46:1 there. The gap defaults to neutral-900; set --focus-ring-offset to match the actual surface. Recommended, not shipped — no app has a dark mode yet.

focus-ring-destructive.$description: Same ring for a field in an error state: destructive-600 (#DC2626), 4.8:1 on white (destructive-500 is only 3.8:1). Replaces the Figma v2 file's Focus ring/Destructive 100 halo.

focus-ring-success.$description: Same ring for a field in a success state: success-600 (#16A34A), 3.3:1 on white — clears the 3:1 minimum. Replaces the Figma v2 file's Focus ring/Success 100 halo.

focus-ring-warning.$description: Same ring for a field in a warning state: warning-600 (#D97706), 3.2:1 on white — clears the 3:1 minimum. Replaces the Figma v2 file's Focus ring/Warning 100 halo.

small.$description: Tailwind v3 `shadow` (bare). Stat cards, small raised surfaces.

large.$description: Tailwind v3 `shadow-lg`. Tooltips and floating panels.

xxlarge.$description: Tailwind v3 `shadow-2xl`. The single heaviest overlay in a view; dead as a named class in every app audited, kept for scale completeness.
